description: This file defines a ResultSet class for 'Project' entities within a database schema, including methods for sorting, filtering, and querying project records based on various criteria such as URL name, archive status, publicity, and recency.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Project
classes.description: A ResultSet class for handling collections of 'Project' records, providing methods for sorting, filtering, and querying projects based on specific attributes and states.

methods.name: sorted_by_columns
methods.description: Returns the columns used for sorting projects, specifically 'url_name_fc' and 'name'.

methods.name: find_by_url_name
methods.description: Finds a project record by its URL name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: not_archived
methods.description: Returns a result set of projects that are not archived.

methods.name: public
methods.description: Returns a result set of projects that are marked as public.

methods.name: stale
methods.description: Returns a result set of projects that are completely in the past based on a pivot date, indicating they can be archived.
